STI-280GE

Saga Telecom

Model
STI-280GE
Product Name
10 port 10/100/1000Mbps Industrial Ethernet Switch
8*10/100/1000M RJ45 port
Fixed Port 2*1000M SFP
Bandwidth 24Gbps
Packet Forwarding 14.88Mpps
MAC 2K
Buffer 2.5M
Transmission Distance
10BASE-T: Cat3, 4, 5 UTP(<250 meter)
100BASE-TX: Cat5 or later UTP(150 meter)
1000BASE-TX: Cat6 or later UTP(150 meter)
Optical Media
SFP: 1000M single and multi-mode optical module, Max distance<100Km
LED Indicator
PWR: Power indicator(green)
PMxX: Power overload indicator(green)
Port: green _10/100M network connection indicator
greentorange _1000M network connection indicator.
9-10: Optical fiber connection indicator(green)
V1: Main power indicator(green)
V2: Slave power indicator(green)
Three groups of independent power input
Power SW: DC12-57V
Operating Temperature -40°C~+75°C
Humidity 10%~90% RH No condensation
Storage Temperature -40°C~+85°C
Humidity
5%~95% RH No condensation
Dimension
Device: 160*130*45mm
L*W*H Packing Box: 280*165*79mm
N.W/G.W(Kg) 0.9Kg/1.1Kg
Lightning 6KV 8/20us; 8KV ESD electrostatic protection
Protection Level IP40
Installation Desktop, Wall, Rack mountable(with mounting hangers)
Warranty 3 Years
